name: ghidraboy
version: 20250830 (upstream release, GhidraBoy-1.7.1) + local port to Ghidra 12.1.4 (ghidra-12.1-port.patch)
notes: Game Boy (SM83) Ghidra loader and language. Upstream is archived and lists only Ghidra 11.x; the zip here is ported to Ghidra 12.1.4. test.sh unpacks it into a throwaway Ghidra user dir, imports an rgbds-built ROM with analyzeHeadless and GameBoyLoader, and checks the SM83 language, rom block and decoded instructions. Passes. Requires Java 21 and rgbds.
